stem:
Consider the following reaction sequence starting from 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)benzaldehyde (P):
P = 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)benzaldehyde
P --[NH₃, H₂/Pt]--> Q
Q --[CHCl₃, alc. KOH]--> R
R --[H₂, Pt]--> S
R --[TsCl, pyridine]--> T
T --[H₂, Pt]--> U
U --[NaCN, DMSO]--> V
Which of the following statement(s) is(are) correct?
(A) Compound S is a secondary amine.
(B) Compound S gives a positive carbylamine test on heating with CHCl₃ and alcoholic KOH.
(C) The total number of sp³-hybridized carbon atoms in one molecule of compound U is 5.
(D) The molecular formula of compound V is C₁₀H₁₂N₂.
Choose all the correct options.

objection.detail: The final step NaCN/DMSO on sulfonamide U is not a valid substitution (no leaving group), so V is not well-defined; also the problem's option D formula cannot be verified.
